== Name

title-macros - verify title macro registration

== Synopsis

.Named title footnote:named[Named title note.] ((Named title term))
[#named-target]
Named paragraph.

[#anonymous-target]
.Anonymous title footnote:[Anonymous title note with ((Note term)).] ((Anonymous title term))
Anonymous paragraph.

Body footnote:[Body note.] and reused footnote:named[].

.Repeated title footnote:named[Named title note.]
Repeated paragraph.

.Referenced title footnote:named[]
Reference paragraph.

.Éva title link:https://example.org/title[Title link] anchor:title-anchor[Title anchor]
Unicode paragraph.

.Discarded title footnote:[Ignored replaced note.] ((Ignored replaced term))
.Attribute title footnote:attribute[{title-value}]
:title-value: Metadata attribute note.
[#attribute-target]
Attribute paragraph.

See <<named-target>>, <<anonymous-target>>, and <<title-anchor>>.
